content: Rampaakanamo sumai, Ishak akembamo Yakub. Incia aemaniakea barakati tee asamea i incia, "Ingkoo inda umembali ukobhawineaka sala samia minaaka i tanga-tangana bhawine Kanaan.
Makanumo, lingkamo i Padan-Aram, i bhanuana Betuel, amana inamu, tee alamo minaaka iwe sumai samia bhawine to ingkoo minaaka i manga anana Laban, witinaina inamu.
Sio-siomo Aulataʼala Mokokuasana abarakati ingkoo, apamembali ingkoo koana-ana koopu-opua, tee apekabharia siwulumu, sabutuna ingkoo umembali opuana bhari lipu.

Sio-siomo Incia adhawuakako barakatina Ibrahim i ingkoo tee i manga siwulumu, sabutuna ingkoo utarima lipu i tampa ingkoo umboore mboomo dhaga to tinaurakamu, siitumo lipu mopadhana idhawuakana Aulataʼala i Ibrahim."
Kasiimpo Ishak arambasaka lingkaana Yakub. Kasiimpomo Yusuf alingka i Padan-Aram, i Laban. Laban sumai anana Betuel tee witinaina Ribka, o inana Yakub tee Esau.

Esau akamatea ande Ishak padhamo aemaniakea barakati to Yakub tee atumpumea alingka i Padan-Aram to aala bhawine minaaka iwe sumai. Esau uka akamatea Ishak asamea i Yusuf wakutuu incia aemaniakea barakati, "Bholi ukobhawineaka samia kabuabua miana Kanaan,"
tee ande Yakub ataʼati pogauna amana tee inana, kasiimpo alingka i Padan-Aram.
Sabutuna, asadaramo Esau ande Ishak, amana, inda apeelua manga bhawinena miana Kanaan.
Rampaakanamo sumai alingkamo Esau i Ismail, kasiimpo aala Mahalat
amembali bhawinena i sambalina rua mia bhawinena mosagaanana. Mahalat satotuuna andina Nebayot, anana Ismail bin Ibrahim.
Pongipina Nabii Yakub i Bait-El
Yakub abholi Bersyeba tee alingka i Haran.
Incia akawa i saangu tampa, kasiimpo akole iwe sumai roonamo matanaeo asoomo. Incia aala saangu bhatu modhaangiana iwe sumai to apamembalia polango, tee akolemo iwe sumai.
Kasiimpo incia uka apongipi. Atokamatamo saangu odha atopakakaro i alamu tee lolona akawa i laiana, kasiimpo manga malaaʼekatina Aulataʼala asapo pene i odha sumai.

I nuncana pongipina sumai, Yakub akamatamo KAWASANA OPU akakaro i saripina tee afirimani, "Iakumo KAWASANA OPU, Aulataʼalana Ibrahim, opuamu, tee Aulataʼalana Ishak. Tana tampa upotidhole sii bhekudhawuaka to ingkoo tee i siwulumu.
Siwulumu bheamembali mboomo ngawuna tana kabharina, tee ingkoo bheujulu i bhara, i timbu, i napa, tee i salata. Rampaakanamo ingkoo tee siwulumu bhari-bharia lipu i alamu bheapotibhaaka barakati.

Satotuuna Iaku kupobhawa tee ingkoo tee bhekujaganiko iapai uka ulingka. Iaku bhekubhawa ingkoo umbuli i lipu sii, roonamo Iaku inda bhekubholiko sampe Iaku kukarajaaia opea mopadhana ijanjiakaku to ingkoo."
Kasiimpomo abhangumo Yakub minaaka i kolena, pogauna, "Satotuuna, KAWASANA OPU aumba i tampa incia sii tee iaku inda kumataua."
Incia amaekamo kasiimpo apogau, "Akokabarakati mpuu tampa incia sii! Sii tantumo Baitulla! Sii bhamba lawana sorogaa!"
Samainawana Yakub abhangumo saeona. Aalamea bhatu ipakena to polango, kasiimpo apakaromea amembali saangu tugu. Sapadhana sumai alaliakamea mina i bhawona.
Incia asarongiakea tampa incia sumai Bait-El;
i piamo itu sarona kota sumai Lus.
Kasiimpomo Yakub atolaumo onina, kooni, "Ande KAWASANA OPU apobhawa tee iaku tee ajaganiaku i dhala ilaloiku sii, adhawuaku kinande to kukandeaka tee pakea to kupakea,
mamudhaakana iaku kumbuli tee kasalaamati i bhanuana amaku, siitumo KAWASANA OPU bheamembali Aulataʼalaku,
tee bhatu ipakaroku mboo tugu sii bheamembali Baitulla. Iaku bhekupasombaaka i Ingkoo sapersapulu minaaka i bhari-bharia idhawuakamu i iaku."

footnotes.text: Mahalat: Incia uka asarongia Basmat i Bhaa. 36:3.
Bait-El: Saro incia sii i nuncana pogau Ibrani akomaʼana "bhanuana Aulataʼala."
